adhkar.text_arabic: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الوَكِيلُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا باللَّهِ العَلِيِّ العَظِيمِ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَبْرَأُ مِنْ حَوْلِي وَقُوَّتِي إِلَى حَوْلِكَ وَقُوَّتِكَ.
adhkar.translation: All praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds. He suffices me, 'and how excellent a Trustee is He!' And there is no power or strength but through Allah, the Sublime, the Almighty. O Allah, I disown any power and strength of mine in favour of Your power and strength.
adhkar.transliteration: Alḥamdu liLlāhi rabbil ʿālamīn, ḥasbiyAllāhu wa niʿmal wakīl wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā biLlāhil ʿaliyyil ʿaẓīm. Allāhumma innī abraʾu min ḥawlī wa quwwatī ilā ḥawlika wa quwwatika.

adhkar.text_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُولِكَ سَيِّدِ المُرْسَلِينَ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ تَعَالَى وَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ، امْتِثَالًا لِأَمْرِكَ وَتَصْدِيقًا لَهُ وَمَحَبَّةً فِيهِ وَشَوْقًا إِلَيْهِ وَتَعْظِيمًا لِقَدْرِهِ، وَلِكَوْنِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَهْلًا لِذَلِكَ، فَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي بِفَضْلِكَ، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ، وَوَفِّقْنِي لِقِرَاءَتِهَا عَلَى الدَّوَامِ بِجَاهِهِ عِنْدَكَ، وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ.
adhkar.translation: O Allah, I seek nearness to You by exaltation of our Master Muḥammad, Your Slave, Prophet and Emissary, the Chief of the Emissaries, may Allah Most High exalt and preserve him and all of them. I do so in obedience to Your command, with conviction in him, with love and yearning for him, and with veneration for his status and for the fact that he, may Allah exalt and preserve him, is worthy of that. Accept it from me by Your grace, and make me one of Your righteous slaves. By virtue of his rank in Your sight, grant me success in reciting it [Dalāʾil al-Khayrāt] continually. May Allah exalt our Master Muḥammad and his Family and Companions one and all.
adhkar.transliteration: Allāhumma innī ataqarrabu ilayka biṣṣalāti ʿala sayyidinā Muḥammadin ʿabdika wa nabiyyika wa rasūlika sayyidil mursalīna ṣallAllāhu taʿālā wasallama ʿalayhi waʿalayhim ajmaʿīna imtithālan li amrika wa taṣdīqan lahu wa maḥabbatan fīhi washawqan ilayhi wataʿẓīman liqadrihi walikawnihi ṣallAllahu ʿalayhi wasallama ahlan lidhalika fataqabbalhā minnī bifaḍlika wajʿalnī min ʿibadikaṣ ṣāliḥīna wawaffiqnī liqirāʾatihā ʿalād dawāmi bijāhihi ʿindaka waṣallAllāhu ʿalā sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa ālihi waṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn.

adhkar.translation: I ask Allah, the Almighty, for forgiveness.
